summary: The page displays a clean dark-theme layout for the build console and terminal, but the MaterialTokens component has a prominent visual layout defect where background specimen text collides with the token labels and technical specs.

issues.title: Overlapping specimen text clashing with token labels
issues.description: Background specimen text extends across the full width of the material preview container, causing it to render directly behind and collide with the token hierarchy labels and spec details.
issues.evidence: Specimen strings such as 'jumps over the lazy dog', 'laid-object surfaces', and 'elevation by refraction' overlap with 'ULTRATHIN', 'THIN', 'REGULAR' and their associated 'panel/XX' spec text.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the background specimen text container to sit strictly behind the preview glass pills on the left, or clip and separate the specimen area from the right-hand metadata column.
